metricHints.clicks: All clicks on the campaign, including repeat clicks from the same visitor.
metricHints.uniqueClicks: Clicks from unique visitors — repeat visits by the same person are not counted.
metricHints.conversions: Number of conversions (target actions) tied to clicks.
metricHints.revenue: Revenue from conversions in USD at the rate on the event date, net of chargebacks: a declined first purchase is subtracted on the day of the decline.
metricHints.cost: Traffic spend in USD. Taken from manually entered cost; shown as “—” when there is none.
metricHints.roi: ROI = (revenue − cost) ÷ cost × 100%. How many percent of the spend came back on top of it.
metricHints.roas: ROAS = revenue ÷ cost. Dollars of revenue per 1 dollar of spend.
metricHints.ctr: CTR = landing views ÷ clicks × 100%. The share of clicks that reached a landing view.
metricHints.cvr: CVR (conversion rate) — the share of clicks that ended in a conversion: conversions ÷ clicks × 100%.
metricHints.cpc: CPC = cost ÷ clicks. Average price of one click.
metricHints.cpa: CPA = cost ÷ conversions. Average price of one conversion.
metricHints.epc: EPC = revenue ÷ clicks. Average revenue per click.
metricHints.pwaInstalls: Number of PWA installs: the install beacon (PWA_INSTALL) plus iOS installs counted at the first Home Screen launch (IOS_INSTALL).
metricHints.tgStarts: Telegram bot starts (TG_START): a visitor opened the organization's bot from a click's link.
metricHints.tgJoins: Telegram channel joins (TG_JOIN), once per click and channel. Split by the Telegram channel dimension.
metricHints.registrations: Registrations at the network — CPA_HOLD events.
metricHints.declines: Rejected by the network — CPA_DECLINE events, chargebacks included.
metricHints.trash: Junk or duplicate leads per the network — CPA_TRASH events.
metricHints.clickToInstall: PWA installs ÷ clicks × 100%. "—" when there are no clicks.
metricHints.installToReg: Registrations ÷ PWA installs × 100%. "—" when there are no installs.
metricHints.regToPurchase: Purchases ÷ registrations × 100%. "—" when there are no registrations.
metricHints.costPerInstall: Cost ÷ PWA installs. "—" without cost or without installs.
metricHints.costPerReg: Cost ÷ registrations. "—" without cost or without registrations.
metricHints.costPerPurchase: Cost ÷ purchases. "—" without cost or without purchases.
metricHints.blocked: Clicks that matched no destination (no flow and no fallback) and were not redirected — SOURCE_FILTER events. They are not counted in Clicks.
metricHints.bots: Clicks flagged as bots by the classifier, including bots that were still sent to a fallback.
metricHints.blockedRate: Blocked ÷ (clicks + blocked) × 100%. "—" when there was no traffic.
metricHints.botRate: Bots ÷ (clicks + blocked) × 100%. "—" when there was no traffic.
metricHints.emptySubs: Clicks that arrived with every sub1–sub10 empty — often Facebook/Instagram traffic opened in the in-app browser, a prefetch or a redirect chain. Recorded as empty, never as an unknown campaign.
metricHints.emptySubsRate: Empty subs ÷ clicks × 100%. The share of clicks whose subs did not arrive, so attribution by sub can't see them. "—" when there are no clicks.
metricHints.push_sent: Notifications queued by broadcasts to the row's subscribers, on the day they were sent. Filled when the report is grouped and filtered only by day, campaign, country or PWA; otherwise "—" — a push has no device, flow or source.
metricHints.push_delivered: Notifications the push service accepted. Same grouping limits as Push sent.
metricHints.push_opened: Notifications opened (first open per notification), counted on the day they were sent.
metricHints.push_unsubscribed: Subscriptions found gone when a notification was sent to them (the push service answered 404/410).
metricHints.push_ctr: Push opened ÷ push delivered × 100%. "—" when nothing was delivered.

notice.title: Conversions by click date
notice.description: Conversions and revenue are counted on the day of the click they are attributed to, next to that day's clicks and spend. Recent days are still filling in: their clicks keep converting.
notice.withoutClick_one: {{count}} conversion without an attributed click is counted on its own date.
notice.withoutClick_other: {{count}} conversions without an attributed click are counted on their own date.

rawRetention.title: Raw clicks are kept {{count}} mo.
rawRetention.report: The range starts earlier. For that time, reports by the main dimensions come from the hourly rollup and are whole; region, city, the funnel and conversions by OS, browser and language are empty.
rawRetention.clickLog: Single clicks older than that were deleted by the plan. The log is empty for the start of the range; the summary reports are kept.
